messages.subject: Yarrow — strategy on Caldera mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

My proposed lines for v3 back to Pemberton Rowe:
- Cap: settle at 135% (Grace pre-cleared this).
- Trigger: reject 4 weeks, counter at 6.
- Shortfall: accept 20% + the certification-delay proviso, bounded to one contract year.
- Add the carbon-fibre index pass-through and lift the escalation cap from 4% to 5% (per our risk note).

OK to proceed on that basis?

James
